name: As Shadows Arise
source:
You travel to a remote town up in the frigid arctic north to find your lost father. 

Daylight here is a luxury and you won't know what you might discover as you set your mark on the town, its inhabitants will also undoubtedly leave their mark on you as the evolving conflict grows like unquenchable fire.

The Seed Institute has established its presence here, its machinations now clear and present in and around it. 

You play as the main male protagonist, you will encounter females and creatures of the night that will attempt to dominate you and you will also encounter submissive types. 

[From [url=https://thetallestking.itch.io/as-shadows-arise]Itch.io[/url]]
